track-my-order.title: How can I track my order?
track-my-order.description: Learn how to find your tracking number and follow your package's journey.

content.heading: Where is my order?
paragraphs: We know you're excited to receive your MarketSphere order! Once a seller ships your item, you can track its progress directly from your account. Most sellers provide tracking details within 1-3 business days of your purchase.

content.heading: How to find your tracking number
paragraphs: You can easily locate your tracking information in your dashboard.
steps: Log in to your MarketSphere account.
Click on 'My Account' and select 'Order History'.
Find the order you want to track and click 'View Details'.
Look for the 'Tracking Number' under the shipping section.
content.tip: If the tracking number is a link, you can click it to go directly to the shipping carrier's website.

content.heading: Tracking as a guest
paragraphs: If you checked out as a guest, you won't have an order history dashboard. Instead, check the email you used during checkout. We always send a shipping confirmation email that contains your tracking link.
content.warning: Check your spam or junk folder if you don't see the shipping confirmation email in your primary inbox.

cancel-an-order.title: How do I cancel an order?
cancel-an-order.description: Find out how to cancel a recent purchase before it ships.

content.heading: The cancellation window
paragraphs: Because our sellers work hard to ship items quickly, there is usually a short window to cancel an order. You can typically cancel your order with no questions asked as long as the seller hasn't marked the item as 'Shipped'.

content.heading: Steps to cancel your order
paragraphs: If your order hasn't shipped yet, follow these steps to request a cancellation:
steps: Navigate to 'My Account' and click on 'Order History'.
Locate the order you wish to cancel.
Click 'Cancel Order' next to the item.
Select a reason for the cancellation and confirm.

content.heading: What if it's too late?
paragraphs: If the 'Cancel Order' button is missing, the seller has already shipped your item. You will need to wait for it to arrive and request a return.
content.tip: You can message the seller directly to see if they can intercept the package, though this isn't guaranteed.

order-hasnt-arrived.title: What should I do if my order hasn't arrived?
order-hasnt-arrived.description: Troubleshoot missing packages and delayed deliveries.

content.heading: Verify your delivery window
paragraphs: First, check the estimated delivery date in your confirmation email. Shipping times vary depending on the seller's location. It's normal for packages to occasionally arrive a day or two late.

content.heading: Check with neighbors
paragraphs: If the tracking shows 'Delivered' but you don't have the package, carriers sometimes leave boxes in hidden spots. Check side doors, porches, and with neighbors.

content.heading: Contacting the seller
paragraphs: If it has been 48 hours since the package was marked delivered, reach out to the seller via your Order History page.
content.warning: If the seller is unresponsive after 3 days, contact MarketSphere Support to open a buyer protection claim.

order-history.title: How to view your order history
order-history.description: Find records of your past purchases and invoices.

content.heading: Accessing Past Orders
paragraphs: Log in and navigate to 'Order History' in your dashboard to view all past and current orders, download invoices, and reorder items.

modify-order.title: Can I modify my order?
modify-order.description: Learn if you can add or remove items after checking out.

content.heading: Making Changes
paragraphs: Once an order is placed, items cannot be added or removed. If you need to make changes, please cancel the order immediately and place a new one.

missing-items.title: An item is missing from my order
missing-items.description: What to do if your package arrives without everything you ordered.

content.heading: Partial Shipments
paragraphs: Some sellers ship items in separate packages. Check your tracking details to see if multiple boxes were dispatched. If not, contact the seller to report the missing item.

wrong-item.title: I received the wrong item
wrong-item.description: Steps to take if the seller sent the incorrect product.

content.heading: Reporting an Error
paragraphs: If you received an item you didn't order, contact the seller within 7 days and include a photo of the incorrect item to arrange an exchange.

guest-checkout.title: Can I check out as a guest?
guest-checkout.description: Learn about buying on MarketSphere without an account.

content.heading: Guest Purchasing
paragraphs: Yes, you can check out as a guest. However, creating an account makes it easier to track orders, manage returns, and save payment methods.

content.heading: Pre-order Timelines
paragraphs: When you buy a pre-order item, the estimated shipping date will be listed on the product page. You will be charged at the time of purchase to reserve your item.

bulk-orders.title: Placing bulk orders
bulk-orders.description: How to purchase large quantities from a seller.

content.heading: Wholesale and Bulk
paragraphs: If you wish to order more than 10 of a specific item, message the seller beforehand. They may offer bulk discounts or need to verify stock levels.

gift-orders.title: Sending an order as a gift
gift-orders.description: Hiding prices and adding gift messages.

content.heading: Gift Options
paragraphs: Select 'This is a gift' at checkout to hide the price on the packing slip. You can also include a custom message for the recipient.

order-status.title: What does my order status mean?
order-status.description: Definitions for Processing, Shipped, and Delivered.

content.heading: Status Definitions
paragraphs: 'Processing' means the seller is packing your item. 'Shipped' means the carrier has it. 'Delivered' means the package has arrived at your address.

shipping-rates.title: How are shipping rates calculated?
shipping-rates.description: Understand how sellers set their shipping prices.

content.heading: Shipping Costs
paragraphs: Shipping rates are determined by individual sellers based on the package weight, dimensions, and the delivery destination.

delivery-times.title: Estimated delivery times
delivery-times.description: How long it takes for a package to arrive.

content.heading: Delivery Estimates
paragraphs: Standard domestic shipping usually takes 3-7 business days. Delivery dates are estimates provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed.

international-shipping.title: Do you ship internationally?
international-shipping.description: Information on cross-border shopping and customs.

content.heading: Global Shipping
paragraphs: Many of our sellers ship worldwide. If international shipping is available, it will be an option during checkout. Buyers are responsible for any customs duties.

change-address.title: Can I change my shipping address?
change-address.description: Updating your address after an order is placed.

content.heading: Address Corrections
paragraphs: If your order hasn't shipped, contact the seller immediately to request an address change. Once shipped, the address cannot be altered.

carriers.title: Which shipping carriers are used?
carriers.description: Common carriers used by MarketSphere sellers.

content.heading: Carrier Selection
paragraphs: Sellers choose their preferred carriers, typically USPS, UPS, or FedEx. The carrier for your order will be noted in your shipping confirmation email.

content.heading: Faster Delivery
paragraphs: If a seller offers expedited shipping, you can select it at checkout for an additional fee. Processing times still apply before the item ships.

free-shipping.title: How do I get free shipping?
free-shipping.description: Finding items with no delivery fees.

content.heading: Free Shipping Filters
paragraphs: You can filter search results to show only items with 'Free Shipping'. Some sellers also offer free shipping if you spend over a certain amount in their shop.

weekend.title: Do you deliver on weekends?
weekend.description: Carrier policies regarding Saturday and Sunday delivery.

content.heading: Weekend Delivery
paragraphs: Weekend delivery depends on the carrier. USPS often delivers on Saturdays, while UPS and FedEx standard services usually deliver Monday through Friday.

request-a-return.title: How do I request a return?
request-a-return.description: Step-by-step instructions on returning an item.

content.heading: Our return policy guidelines
paragraphs: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused, in its original packaging, and in the same condition you received it.
content.warning: Personalized goods and digital downloads cannot be returned unless they arrived defective.

content.heading: How to start a return request
paragraphs: Initiating a return is easy through your dashboard.
steps: Go to 'My Account' and select 'Order History'.
Find the item and click 'Return Item'.
Choose a reason and upload photos if damaged.
Submit the request for the seller to review.

content.heading: Shipping your item back
paragraphs: Once approved, you'll receive a printable label. Attach it to your package and drop it off at the carrier.
content.tip: Always ask the carrier for a drop-off receipt as proof of return.

receive-my-refund.title: When will I receive my refund?
receive-my-refund.description: Understand the timeline for getting your money back.

content.heading: The refund timeline
paragraphs: If you canceled before shipping, refunds are processed immediately. For returns, the seller must inspect the item first.

content.heading: Original payment methods
paragraphs: Once issued, bank processing times apply.
steps: Credit/Debit Cards: 3–5 business days.
PayPal: Within 24 hours.
Store Credit: Instantly.

content.heading: Why is my refund delayed?
paragraphs: Delays usually occur if the bank is processing over a weekend, or if the return package is still in transit to the seller.

content.heading: 30-Day Window
paragraphs: Buyers have 30 days from the delivery date to initiate a return. Items must be in original condition unless reported damaged upon arrival.

content.heading: Return Costs
paragraphs: If the item is defective or incorrect, the seller covers return shipping. If you simply changed your mind, the cost of the return label will be deducted from your refund.

exchange.title: Can I exchange an item?
exchange.description: How to swap an item for a different size or color.

content.heading: Exchanges
paragraphs: Currently, the best way to exchange an item is to return the original for a refund and place a new order for the desired size or color.

damaged.title: My item arrived damaged
damaged.description: What to do if your item was broken in transit.

content.heading: Damaged Goods
paragraphs: Take clear photos of the damaged item and the shipping box. Submit a return request immediately and upload the photos to ensure a full refund.

non-returnable.title: Non-returnable items
non-returnable.description: Items that are exempt from the standard return policy.

content.heading: Final Sale Items
paragraphs: Perishable goods, custom/personalized products, intimates, and digital downloads are final sale and cannot be returned.

return-status.title: Checking your return status
return-status.description: How to track a return package.

content.heading: Tracking Returns
paragraphs: You can track your return package using the tracking number on the return label provided to you. Once the seller receives it, they have 48 hours to issue the refund.

content.heading: Safe Packing
paragraphs: Always use the original box if possible. Secure the item with bubble wrap or paper to prevent it from shifting during transit.

return-label.title: I can't print my return label
return-label.description: What to do if you don't have a printer.

content.heading: Label Alternatives
paragraphs: If you don't have a printer, many carriers (like UPS and USPS) allow you to scan a QR code from your phone at the drop-off location, and they will print the label for you.

content.heading: Payment Options
paragraphs: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, and Apple Pay. We use secure encryption to protect your data.

content.heading: Declined Payments
paragraphs: Payments often fail due to incorrect billing addresses, expired cards, or anti-fraud blocks by your bank. Try re-entering your details or contacting your bank.

security.title: Is my credit card information secure?
security.description: How we protect your financial data.

content.heading: Payment Security
paragraphs: Yes. MarketSphere uses industry-standard SSL encryption and partners with Stripe for payment processing. We do not store your full credit card number on our servers.

store-credit.title: How to use store credit
store-credit.description: Applying your balance to a purchase.

content.heading: Using Your Balance
paragraphs: If you have store credit, it will automatically apply to your cart at checkout. You can pay any remaining balance with your credit card.

content.heading: Applying Codes
paragraphs: Enter your promo code in the 'Discount Code' box at checkout and click 'Apply'. Note that most codes cannot be stacked.

tax.title: Why was I charged sales tax?

content.heading: Sales Tax
paragraphs: MarketSphere is required by law to collect sales tax on orders shipping to jurisdictions that mandate it. The tax rate is based on the delivery address.

content.heading: Display Currency
paragraphs: All prices are displayed in USD by default. If your payment method uses a different currency, your bank will determine the exchange rate and may charge a conversion fee.

change-account-information.title: How can I change my account information?
change-account-information.description: Update your name, email, addresses, and payment methods.

content.heading: How to update your personal details
paragraphs: An accurate profile ensures you receive your order notifications.
steps: Log in and navigate to 'Account Settings'.
Click on 'Personal Information'.
Edit the fields you wish to change.
Click 'Save Changes'.

content.heading: Changing your email address
paragraphs: To change your email, go to 'Login & Security'. After entering your new email, we will send a verification link to confirm.
content.warning: You will need your current password to authorize an email change.

reset-my-password.title: How do I reset my password?
reset-my-password.description: Regain access if you've forgotten your password.

content.heading: Requesting a reset link
paragraphs: To get a secure password reset link, follow these instructions:
steps: Go to the MarketSphere Login page.
Click 'Forgot Password?'.
Enter your email address and click 'Send Reset Link'.
content.tip: Password reset links expire after 30 minutes for your security.

content.heading: Didn't receive the email?
paragraphs: Check your spam folder and ensure you entered the exact email address used for registration.

content.heading: Registration
paragraphs: Click 'Sign Up' in the top right corner. Enter your email and a strong password, or sign up quickly using your Google or Apple account.

delete.title: How do I delete my account?
delete.description: Permanently removing your profile and data.

content.heading: Account Deletion
paragraphs: Go to 'Account Settings', scroll to the bottom, and click 'Delete Account'. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

2fa.title: Setting up two-factor authentication
2fa.description: Adding an extra layer of security.

content.heading: Enabling 2FA
paragraphs: Protect your account by navigating to 'Login & Security' and enabling 2FA. You will receive a text message code every time you log in from a new device.

content.heading: Email Subscriptions
paragraphs: Go to 'Notifications' in your settings to toggle off promotional emails. You cannot unsubscribe from transactional emails like order confirmations.

content.heading: Public Profiles
paragraphs: By default, your profile is private. If you leave reviews, your chosen Display Name will be public. You can change your Display Name in your settings.

content.heading: Social Logins
paragraphs: You can link or unlink third-party logins in the 'Security' section. This allows you to log in without a password.

download-data.title: How to download your data
download-data.description: Requesting a copy of your personal data.

content.heading: Data Requests
paragraphs: Under GDPR and CCPA guidelines, you can request a file of all your data by going to 'Privacy Settings' and clicking 'Request Data Export'.

wishlist-work.title: How does the wishlist work?
wishlist-work.description: Discover how to save your favorite items for later.

content.heading: Adding items to your wishlist
paragraphs: Saving an item is incredibly simple. When you're looking at a product you like, just look for the little heart icon.
steps: Navigate to any product page.
Click the 'Heart' icon next to the 'Add to Cart' button.
The heart will turn solid brown.
content.tip: Items in your wishlist are not reserved. If an item has low stock, it might sell out!

content.heading: Moving items to your cart
paragraphs: Open your wishlist and click the 'Add to Cart' button directly beneath the product to purchase it.

edit-cart.title: How to edit your shopping cart

content.heading: Updating the Cart
paragraphs: Click the cart icon to view your items. Use the +/- buttons to change the quantity, or click 'Remove' to take an item out of your cart.

save-later.title: Using 'Save for Later'
save-later.description: Moving items out of your active cart.

content.heading: Save for Later
paragraphs: Not ready to buy? Click 'Save for Later' beneath a cart item. It will move to a separate list below your cart so you can purchase it easily in the future.

share.title: Can I share my wishlist?
share.description: Sending your saved items to friends.

content.heading: Sharing Lists
paragraphs: Yes, you can make your wishlist public in its settings. Once public, you can copy the URL and send it to friends and family for gift ideas.

cart-errors.title: Why did my cart empty itself?

content.heading: Session Expiration
paragraphs: If you are browsing as a guest, your cart may clear if you close your browser. Log in to your account to ensure your cart is saved across devices.

size.title: How do I find my size?

content.heading: Size Charts
paragraphs: Sellers provide custom size charts on their apparel listings. Always refer to the specific item's size guide in the image gallery or description, as sizing varies between brands.

availability.title: How to check product availability
availability.description: Knowing if an item is ready to ship.

content.heading: Stock Status
paragraphs: Product pages indicate if an item is in stock. If stock is low, you will see a 'Only X left' warning near the Add to Cart button.

content.heading: Restocks
paragraphs: If an item is sold out, you can click 'Notify me when available' to receive an email alert if the seller restocks the product.

content.heading: Zero Tolerance Policy
paragraphs: MarketSphere prohibits the sale of counterfeit goods. If you suspect an item is inauthentic, please report it immediately.

content.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Scroll to the bottom of any product page and click 'Report this item'. Select a reason (e.g., counterfeit, prohibited item) and our Trust & Safety team will investigate.

warranties.title: Do products come with a warranty?

content.heading: Warranties
paragraphs: Warranties are provided at the discretion of the seller or the original manufacturer. Check the product description to see if a warranty is included.

contact.title: How do I contact a seller?
contact.description: Sending a message to a shop.

content.heading: Messaging Sellers
paragraphs: You can message a seller by clicking the 'Contact Seller' button on their shop profile or directly from your Order History page regarding a specific purchase.

content.heading: Seller Feedback
paragraphs: A seller's rating is an average of all reviews left by verified buyers. Reading reviews is a great way to gauge a seller's reliability and item quality.

content.heading: Reporting Shops
paragraphs: If a seller is abusive, attempting to take transactions off-platform, or scamming, click the 'Report Shop' button on their storefront to notify our moderation team.

become-seller.title: How to become a seller
become-seller.description: Start your own shop on MarketSphere.

content.heading: Selling on MarketSphere
paragraphs: Scroll to the footer and click 'Sell with Us'. You'll need to fill out an application, provide identity verification, and link a bank account to receive payouts.

policies.title: Where to find a seller's policies

content.heading: Shop Policies
paragraphs: Every seller has a 'Policies' tab on their storefront detailing their specific shipping timelines and whether they accept custom orders.

content.heading: Buyer Protection
paragraphs: If you cannot resolve an issue with a seller directly after 48 hours, you can escalate the issue to MarketSphere Support for mediation and potential refunds.

write.title: How to write a review
write.description: Sharing your feedback on a purchase.

content.heading: Leaving Feedback
paragraphs: After your item is delivered, go to your Order History and click 'Leave a Review'. You can rate the item from 1 to 5 stars and leave written feedback.

edit.title: Can I edit or delete a review?

content.heading: Updating Reviews
paragraphs: Yes. Go to your public profile to see your past reviews. You can edit or delete a review up to 60 days after it was originally posted.

guidelines.title: Review guidelines and rules
guidelines.description: What is and isn't allowed in reviews.

content.heading: Review Rules
paragraphs: Reviews must be about the product itself. Reviews containing profanity, personal information, or complaints about shipping carriers (which the seller cannot control) may be removed.

content.heading: Photo Reviews
paragraphs: When writing a review, click the camera icon to upload up to 3 photos of the item. This helps other buyers see what the product looks like in real life.

push.title: Managing push notifications
push.description: App alerts for orders and messages.

content.heading: App Settings
paragraphs: If you use our mobile app, you can toggle push notifications for order updates and new seller messages in the app's settings menu.

sms.title: How to opt into SMS text alerts

content.heading: Text Alerts
paragraphs: During checkout, you can check the box to receive SMS updates about your delivery. Standard messaging rates apply.

content.heading: Unsubscribing
paragraphs: Click the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any marketing email, or update your preferences in the 'Notifications' section of your account settings.

content.heading: Our Terms
paragraphs: Our Terms of Service govern your use of the platform. By creating an account, you agree to abide by our community guidelines and buying/selling rules.

content.heading: Data Privacy
paragraphs: We take your privacy seriously. Our Privacy Policy outlines what data we collect, how it is used to improve your experience, and who we share it with.

content.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: MarketSphere uses cookies to keep you logged in and personalize your shopping experience. You can manage cookie preferences via your browser settings.

content.heading: Web Accessibility
paragraphs: MarketSphere strives to make our platform accessible to everyone. We actively test our site against WCAG guidelines. If you encounter barriers, please let us know.

contact-us.title: Contact MarketSphere Support
contact-us.description: How to reach our customer service team.

content.heading: Get in Touch
paragraphs: Need more help? You can reach our support team via live chat in the bottom right corner of the screen, or by emailing support@marketsphere.com.
